newsitem.title: USA: U.S. reserve assets rose in October.
newsitem.headline: U.S. reserve assets rose in October.

text.p: The Treasury Department said on Thursday that U.S. reserve assets rose $49 million in October to $75.558 billion from $75.509 billion in September.
Total U.S. holdings of foreign currencies fell to $38.77 billion in October from $38.86 billion in September.
Gold stock totaled $11.05 billion in each month.
Special Drawing Rights with the International Monetary Fund were up to $10.23 billion from $10.18 billion in September.
The value of the U.S. reserve position with the IMF rose to $15.52 billion in October from $15.42 billion in September.
